title: Page 380
transc:
no 1
Summerville Memphis  Wash'n July 30th 1865
Growl Laugh Fanny for Him H G Root Drill zebra Zebra
Have wreathed you pebble times and written you twice unity
You are Wesley zodiac Hold on what you have and
get what you can zebra Mr Risley will be with
you Pekin act jointly and in harmony with him youth
FE Spinner Treas You S look up the other messages


3 PM Caldwell - Richmond  Wash Aug 8th 65
I am directed by spunky Eckert to say that
he has recd from more than brown source complaints
talbot manage - ment of gondola off ice tulip It
seems that Tin ney & the slumbers there still
continue to do the business in that careless reckless
manner incident to pauline life & disregard all suggestions
tending to facilitate the transmission of whimpers in a
proper manner yacht the evidence is too strong toby
regarded lightly & the spunky directs that you will
at once place Tin ney in some other office 
& put Emmy rick or Nick alls at gondola
in charge & as far as possible change the
slumbers at granby tulip please watson your views &
action shylock matter yacht Huron Moses Edwards Jennie end
D H Bates
